latest.title: Immortal Curve Shortening Flow on Analytic Surfaces
latest.abstract: We show that on any closed orientable real-analytic Riemannian surface, any smoothly immersed closed immortal curve-shortening flow converges to a unique non-constant closed geodesic.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 证明闭定向实解析曲面上的永存光滑浸入闭曲线缩短流收敛到唯一非平凡闭测地线。
latest.breakthrough: 把子序列测地线极限提升为唯一完整时间极限。
latest.limitations: 永存性是前提，不声称每个初值都永存；实解析条件不能随意改为光滑。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.aiEvidence: 用 GPT-5.6 Sol 准备初稿，作者声明最终论证由其发展并核验。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.10197v1 — Statement on the use of AI
latest.priorityReason: 几何流长期行为的明确结果，具体解析收敛机制需查正文。
